item.title: Sauna360 Recalls Infrared Saunas, Hybrid Infrared Saunas and Infrared Kits Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire and Burn Hazards
item.company: Sold At: Costco stores and pool and spa dealerships nationwide and online at Costco.com and other online sites from May 2013 through July 2026 for between $6000 and $13,000.
item.brand: Sold At: Costco stores and pool and spa dealerships nationwide and online at Costco.com and other online sites from May 2013 through July 2026 for between $6000 and $13,000.
item.product: Infrared Saunas, Hybrid Infrared Saunas and Infrared Kits
item.summary: This recall involves various infrared and hybrid sauna models and infrared (IR) kits. Customers who purchased custom rooms built with IR panels can check for the words "Saunalogic," "Infralogic," "Carbonflex," or "Tylö" on their control panel or locate their product manual. Customers who purchased pre-configured infrared sauna rooms can identify their product by the brand badge on the front frame panel, the control panel, the manual or the logo handle. Consumers can also find the serial number located under the lower bench or on the wall under the upper bench depending on the unit and provide Sauna360 the serial number to determine if they have a recalled sauna. item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Infrared Saunas, Hybrid Infrared Saunas and Infrared Kits.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the infrared and hybrid saunas immediately and contact Sauna360 to schedule a free in-home repair from a professional installer.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
